description: Monthly insider-sentiment score for a ticker (MSPR-style, -100 to +100; positive = net buying conviction), one point per month, defaulting to roughly the last 12 months. Automatically excludes 10b5-1 plan trades so the score reflects discretionary conviction, not pre-scheduled dispositions. Use get_transactions or get_signals for the trade-level detail behind a given month. Requires Business plan.

months.description: Number of trailing months of sentiment to return, ending with the most recent. Minimum 1, maximum 60. Omit to use the backend default (~12).

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol, case-insensitive, e.g. AAPL.

name: get_sentiment
